about: Single source of truth for every art/sound file. The game loads the first of public/<roots.licensed>/<path>, public/<roots.cc0>/<path>, public/<roots.placeholder>/<path> that exists with the right size. Edit this file, then run `npm run assets:placeholders && npm run assets:docs`.

craftpix-monsters.name: CraftPix: Free RPG Monster Sprites Pixel Art (demon, dragon, jinn, lizard, medusa, small dragon; idle, walk, attack, hurt, death)
craftpix-monsters.licence: craftpix.net Freebies licence: free for commercial and personal projects; the raw files must NOT be redistributed. Keep them in public/assets/licensed/ (gitignored). The licence also bans using the files to train AI.

batareya-frames.name: Batareya: Pixel Art CCG-like Frames (free pack, 25 frames, 64×96)
batareya-frames.licence: Free for free and commercial projects; may not be redistributed or resold (itch.io page, checked 2026-11-15). Keep it in public/assets/licensed/ (gitignored).

fga-magic-fx.name: Free Game Assets (CraftPix): Free Pixel Magic Sprite Effects Pack
fga-magic-fx.licence: CraftPix freebie, name-your-own-price. The itch.io page states no licence; the publisher points to the CraftPix file licence for its packs: no redistribution of the raw files. Keep them in public/assets/licensed/ (gitignored). Check the licence on download.

own.name: Altered Arena original (placeholder generator)
own.licence: MIT, same as the code. Fine to commit.

craftpix-knight.name: CraftPix: Knight Characters Free Sprite (black, bronze and silver knight; cartoon, not pixel art)
craftpix-knight.licence: craftpix.net Freebies licence: free for commercial and personal projects; the raw files must NOT be redistributed. Keep them in public/assets/licensed/ (gitignored). The licence also bans using the files to train AI.

craftpix-wizard-chars.name: CraftPix: Wizard Character Free Sprite (purple, fire and ice wizard; cartoon, not pixel art)
craftpix-wizard-chars.licence: craftpix.net Freebies licence: free for commercial and personal projects; the raw files must NOT be redistributed. Keep them in public/assets/licensed/ (gitignored). The licence also bans using the files to train AI.

kenney-pixel-ui.name: Kenney: Pixel UI Pack
kenney-pixel-ui.licence: CC0 1.0 (public domain): License.txt in the pack. May be committed.

kenney-fantasy-borders.name: Kenney: Fantasy UI Borders
kenney-fantasy-borders.licence: CC0 1.0 (public domain): License.txt in the pack. May be committed.
